name: Irongate Security Vest
description:
A tactical vest in high-visibility yellow-green with SECURITY printed in large block letters across the back in retroreflective ink. Multiple exterior pockets with hook-and-loop and zipper closures — large enough for a baton, restraints, or a compact medkit. The front closes with a heavy-duty zipper and a snap-button placket. The back panel has a drag handle stitched into the collar. No armor, no electronics — just a well-organized piece of gear that announces your role and holds your equipment.

Irongate supplies roughly 40% of the private security firms operating in Tiers 2 and 3 of GLMZ. This vest is so common it has become almost invisible — which creates its own particular problems for the people who depend on being recognized as security.
what_it_says: You're working a job that requires you to be seen. Whether that job is legitimate is a separate question.
worn_by: opportunists who bought one at surplus
story_hooks: Irongate vests are available at three different surplus markets on the Shelf — someone is stealing them in bulk and the company hasn't reported the thefts
A string of Tier 3 commercial burglaries all involved someone wearing an Irongate vest; no one questions security personnel
The drag handle on a particular vest has been reinforced beyond spec — someone modified it to serve a different purpose
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian sleeveless vest with a bold, unmistakable silhouette. The high-visibility yellow-green base is dominated by large retroreflective 'SECURITY' text across the back, making the wearer instantly recognizable at distance or in low light. Front is clean and professional; back announces function loudly.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, layered fit designed to wear over standard underclothing or light armor. Cut allows freedom of movement for physical security work. Armholes are generous to accommodate augmented limbs or repeated reaching motions.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-duty synthetic-cotton blend with retroreflective ink treatment on printed text. Exterior pockets use reinforced ballistic weave at stress points.
physical_description.texture: Smooth primary fabric with slight sheen from synthetic content. Hook-and-loop fasteners have a rough, tactile quality. Retroreflective ink adds subtle bumpy texture under fingertips.
physical_description.color_scheme: High-visibility safety yellow-green (ISO 20471 standard) as dominant color. Black retroreflective block letters spelling 'SECURITY' across back and shoulders. Muted gray or black zipper hardware.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty industrial zipper down center front with reinforced stitching. Snap-button placket overlay for security and durability. Hook-and-loop on smaller pockets for quick access; larger equipment pockets use robust zippers.
distinctive_features: Drag handle stitched into collar for emergency extraction or control
Multiple exterior pockets sized for baton, restraint equipment, compact medkit
Retroreflective text visible in vehicle headlights and flashlight beams
Reinforced stress points at zipper and pocket corners
No internal electronics or armor plating — pure mechanical functionality
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 functional workwear. Affordable, mass-produced, standard-issue for contract security across GLMZ.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals private security contractor or licensed protection specialist. Worn by door staff, asset escorts, facility monitors, and freelance bodyguards. The ubiquity of the vest (40% market share for Irongate alone) means wearing one no longer guarantees authority — it has become background noise in Tier 3 urban zones.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically well-maintained but worn; zipper edges show patina, retroreflective text may have minor scuff marks from contact with doorframes or equipment. Pockets show crease patterns from repeated tool storage. No intentional distressing — functional wear only.
